messages.body_plain:
Hi, I'm having the same error, but trying setContentType() didn't fix it. When I ran it, it says
 could not find function "setContentType"

On Friday, 6 July 2012 21:30:21 UTC+10, SantoshMarigowda wrote:
> This issue is solved by setting content type:
>
> [root@localhost R]# cat /var/www/R/hello.R.2
> setContentType("image/png")
> t <- tempfile()
> x <- c(1,3,6,9,12)
> y <- c(1.5,2,7,8,15)
> png(t,type="cairo")
> plot(x,y)
> dev.off()
> sendBin(readBin(t,'raw',n=file.info <http://file.info>(t)$size))
> unlink(t)
> DONE
>
> Regards
> Santosh
>
> On Friday, July 6, 2012 11:36:21 AM UTC+1, SantoshMarigowda wrote:
> > I think I need to set the content type. Let me try.
> >
